subject: Re: Executive roundtable inclusion & logo tiers — Clarification
messages:
From: Lara Bennett <lara@cloudcon.org>
To: Priyom Das <priyom_das@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Derek Shaw <derek@eventops.cloudcon.org>
Date: 2026-11-12T09:15:00-08:00
Subject: Sponsorship package — exec roundtable & logo tiers

Hi Priyom,

Thanks again for the call earlier — really appreciate Redwood's interest in CloudCon. I attached the current sponsorship pack for your reference (Sponsorship_Pack_CloudCon2027.pdf). A couple of open items came up on our side that I wanted to clarify before we finalize the DocuSign: 

- Executive roundtable: the gold package includes one seat in the executive roundtable. Can you confirm whether Redwood needs the lead seat (introduction) or just a participant slot?
- Logo tier: we have two options for the gold slot — lead session co-branding (logo on stage backdrop + session slides) vs. lobby banner placement. Which is higher priority for you?
- Speaking slot: gold comes with a 30-min panel; we can convert that to a 20-min moderated exec conversation if you prefer more intimate format.

If you can reply with preferences and any brand assets timeline, I’ll push the agreement to DocuSign. Also, do you have a standard PO wording we should expect on our side for the reserved capacity?

Best,

Lara Bennett
Sponsorship Director | CloudCon Events
phone: +1 415-555-0189
attachments: Sponsorship_Pack_CloudCon2027.pdf (PDF, 2.1MB)
From: Priyom Das <priyom_das@redwoodinference.com>
To: Lara Bennett <lara@cloudcon.org>
Cc: Stephanie Nguyen <stephanie_nguyen@redwoodinference.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwoodinference.com>
Date: 2026-11-13T10:02:00-08:00
Subject: Re: Sponsorship package — exec roundtable & logo tiers

Hi Lara — thanks for the deck and the summary. Looping in Steph and Marissa on execution. Quick answers below and a few asks so we can turn the agreement around this week: 

- Executive roundtable: we’d like the lead seat (short intro + 2–3 questions) if CloudCon can keep it to a 20–25 minute segment (we want to avoid a long presentation).
- Logo tier: priority is stage & session co-branding (backdrop + slide treatment). Lobby banner is nice-to-have but not required.
- Speaking slot: agree to a 20-min moderated exec conversation instead of a full 30-min panel — keeps it tight and focused.

Timelines / asks: 
- Please send the DocuSign with the updated language reflecting the lead roundtable seat and 20-min speaking format.
- We’ll provide final logo assets (SVG + PNG) and preferred color lockups by 2026-11-21.
- Any exhibitor adjacency guarantees (corner booth, near food court) should be spelled out in the SOW.

I’ve attached our proposed redlines to the agreement for your legal team (Sponsorship_Agreement_v3.pdf) — mostly clarifying deliverables and lead-gen credit timing. If you prefer, Steph can take the final negotiation call.

Thanks — Priyom
Priyom Das
Enterprise Sales Manager | Redwood Inference
Cell: +1 650-555-0199
attachments: Sponsorship_Agreement_v3.pdf (PDF, redlines)
From: Stephanie Nguyen <stephanie_nguyen@redwoodinference.com>
To: Priyom Das <priyom_das@redwoodinference.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwoodinference.com>
Date: 2026-11-15T08:20:00-08:00
Subject: Fwd: Sponsorship package — negotiation points (internal)

Priyom / Marissa — internal notes before we reply to Lara: 

1) Roundtable: Ask for explicit 8-person max and a 5-minute intro slot (we lead a 2-question opener + short closing remark). Saying 20–25 min total is fine; aim for 20.
2) Speaking: Convert to \"executive conversation\" — 20 minutes, moderator provided by CloudCon, Redwood to supply one slide and the moderator brief.
3) Logo placement: Require \"primary session co-branding\" on stage backdrop, session slides, and event app session page (not just lobby). If they push back, accept stage + session slides only.
4) Booth: Request corner placement or adjacency to partner lounge. If they can't promise, secure a dedicated branding pole near the booth.
5) Lead gen: Ask for CSV of scanned leads + opt-in timestamp within 48 hours of event and two pre-event target lists (attendee interest groups).
6) Payment/PO: We can accept a standard PO but require Net30 after event if we are providing an invoice; prefer invoice in lieu of PO for faster routing.

If Lara sends DocuSign with our redlines accepted we can approve. If they decline core items (roundtable lead, primary co-branding, lead gen timing) push to an exec escalation — bring in Marc for sign-off.

I'll draft a short reply to Lara — want to keep tone collaborative but firm.

- Steph
VP, North America Field Marketing | Redwood Inference
From: Lara Bennett <lara@cloudcon.org>
To: Priyom Das <priyom_das@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Derek Shaw <derek@eventops.cloudcon.org>, Stephanie Nguyen <stephanie_nguyen@redwoodinference.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwoodinference.com>
Date: 2026-11-17T16:42:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Sponsorship package — exec roundtable & logo tiers

Hi all — thanks for the clear answers and the redlines, Priyom. Good news — the team accepted most of the changes. Summary below (final language will be in DocuSign):

- Executive roundtable: We can confirm a lead seat with a 20-minute slot (5-minute intro + 2–3 guided questions). Table size limited to 8 execs.
- Speaking slot: Switched to \"executive conversation\" (20 minutes); CloudCon will supply a moderator and AV for a single slide.
- Logo placement: We can confirm primary session co-branding on the stage backdrop and session slides, plus the session detail page in the event app. Lobby banner remains optional.
- Booth: We will make every effort to assign a corner booth near the partner lounge; final booth map is shared 30 days before the event.
- Lead gen: CSV export delivered within 48 hours post-event; opt-in timestamps included.

Attached are the updated agreement and our brand guidelines with file names: Sponsorship_Agreement_v3.pdf (with our counters) and Brand_Guidelines_LogoAssets.zip. Please review — if everything looks good, sign via DocuSign at: https://www.docusign.com/en/link/abc123-ds

Final asks from CloudCon: please upload the final logo package to the link in the DocuSign or email to events@cloudcon.org by 2026-11-21 to make the artwork deadline.

Looking forward to having Redwood as a Gold sponsor — let me know if you'd like a quick call to finalize.

Best,
Lara Bennett
Sponsorship Director | CloudCon Events
attachments: Sponsorship_Agreement_v3.pdf (PDF, counters), Brand_Guidelines_LogoAssets.zip (ZIP, logos)
